free_tier.stated: Web Folder Basic: 'No capacity limit. Auto-deleted 90 hours after upload.' API flow: 10 files per WebFolder, 999 GiB max per file

retention.stated: Auto-deleted 90 hours after upload.' API flow: 10 files per WebFolder, 999 GiB max per file

egress.terms: No egress charge; instead a hard time gate — free download window is 48 h (<10 GB), 12 h (10-20 GB), 6 h (>=20 GB); after that a $2+ Download Pass or $5 expiry extension is required

tooling: Documented v2 REST API at api.file.kiwi (POST /v2/folders returns presigned R2 PUT URLs), 36 h presigned-URL validity, client-side E2E keys (RFC 8188 AES-128-GCM); no rclone backend
chaining: No account at all — one API call creates a folder; anonymous IDs are unlimited. Multiplication is trivial, the 90-hour delete is the wall
limits_note: 999 GiB/file; 10 files/WebFolder; 90 h total life; download window collapses to 6 h for >=20 GB; 1 concurrent chunk upload; download count capped at 3 in Korea
